author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಾಲಶೂಲದಿ ನರಳಿ ಹೆಣಗಾಡೊ ಬದಲಿನಲಿ
ಕಾಲು ಚಾಚಲು ಕಲಿಯೊ ಹಾಸಿಗೆಯ ಅಳತೆ
ಹಾಲು ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ತೆರದಿ ಹದವರಿತು ಬದುಕುತಿರೆ
ಕಾಲಕೂಟವೆ ಸಿಗದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Instead of groaning and struggling on the stake of debt,
learn to stretch your legs to the length of your bed;
if you live knowing the right measure, like milk and sugar,
you will never meet the deadly poison, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The Kannada proverb says: stretch your legs only as far as your mattress. Live within your means, in the right proportion, and you will avoid the poison of debt.
